Headline: Revenue concentrates in North, Electronics, and Q4.
          Discounts didn't raise items/order; returns ran higher.
Evidence: $184K from 1,267 orders; Q4 = 34.6% of revenue;
          returns 7.2% (no discount) -> 12.6% (21-30% off)
Caveat:   top discount band has only 103 orders -- association, not proof
caption: Notice the caveats make this analysis more credible, not less.
